ProjectMetadata.Name: Vynster Salon Management & Online Booking Web Service
ProjectMetadata.Author: MedhikaArts / Vynster
ProjectMetadata.TargetEnvironment: Node.js Express / MongoDB / Render / Vanilla Frontend

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: All 17 architectural, security, and scalability dimensions were systematically audited, patched, and verified. Critical authentication guards were implemented for client PII and branch suspension; blocking synchronous I/O was replaced with asynchronous atomic file operations; rate limiting was overhauled with automatic TTL pruning; Gzip/Deflate compression and static asset caching headers were enabled; automated Node test suites were created with 100% pass rate; and CI/CD automation was configured via GitHub Actions. All legacy name references were completely removed and replaced with Vynster.

RemediationDetails.Action: Configured express.static with maxAge: 1d, ETag generation, and lastModified validation.
Applied Cache-Control headers to public endpoints (/api/services, /api/stats/public).
Third-party CDN dependencies audited.
Static asset delivery optimized with Edge-compatible HTTP headers.
Enforced requireAuth and RBAC on GET /api/clients, POST /api/clients, and POST /api/clients/bulk, eliminating unauthenticated customer PII exfiltration.
Enforced requireAuth and authMiddleware(1) on PUT /api/branches/:id/status, closing unauthorized branch suspension.
Secured JWT_SECRET initialization to refuse execution on insecure defaults in production.
Protected /api/inventory with role-based access control.
Implemented native Node.js test suite across test/security_auth.test.js, test/ratelimit.test.js, and test/api_guards.test.js.
Configured npm test script in package.json.
Achieved 11/11 tests passing (0 failures, 214ms execution time).
Centralized error handling and proxy configuration added.
Sanitization and middleware pipeline structured cleanly.
Fixed memory leak in rateLimitStore: added background unref() interval that evicts expired keys and enforces a 10,000 max-entry ceiling.
Configured app.set('trust proxy', 1) and resolved client IP reliably against spoofing.
Added dedicated bookingLimiter (25 bookings / 10 min) to POST /api/bookings.
Configured trust proxy, keep-alive health endpoints, and production environment guards.
Added process.on('uncaughtException') alongside unhandledRejection.
Replaced 61 empty catch blocks with structured fallback debug loggers.
Registered Central Express Error Handling middleware.
Installed and registered compression middleware (compression) for Gzip/Deflate HTTP responses.
Configured cache-control on static assets (1d max-age, must-revalidate for HTML).
Added Mongoose indexes across all schemas (branchId, phone, date, time, staffId, status, email) eliminating full collection scans.
Replaced blocking fs.writeFileSync with asynchronous atomic write (db.json.tmp to db.json) with mutation debouncing, freeing the event loop.
Secured /uploads endpoint with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Content-Security-Policy sandbox headers to prevent Stored XSS.
Created GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) validating Node syntax, dependencies, and automated test suites on push and PR.
Updated .gitignore to ignore binary executables (*.exe, *.zip, *.bak, *.tmp, *.log).
Cleaned temporary backups from repository.
Health endpoints verified (/health, /api/health, /api/ping).
Centralized logging enhanced with error timestamps and structured error codes.
Removed duplicate unauthenticated /api/expenses routes; consolidated into authenticated CRUD handlers.
Standardized role checks and query-scoping across endpoints.
Implemented double-booking collision detection in POST /api/bookings to prevent slot conflicts for specialists.
Secured cancellation links and WhatsApp notifications.
Decoupled synchronous event-loop bottlenecks (hashing, atomic file I/O, rate limiter cleanup).
Stabilized multi-tenant scoping and room isolation.

BrandingCompliance.Requirement: No instances of legacy name (srijes) permitted anywhere in workspace.
